q03.answer: You are allowed to repeat a course up to a maximum of two (2) times. If you fail a course more than two times and your status is dismissed, your appeal for reinstatement may not be considered (Source: 2025 Academic Handbook.pdf, page 23).

q04.answer: You can withdraw from a subject in a long trimester up to week seven (7) [Source: 2025 Academic Handbook.pdf, page 24].

q05.answer:
To pass a subject, students must achieve an overall mark of at least 40%.

However, it's important to note the following conditions:
*   Students must pass both their formative and summative assessments.
*   If a student fails their summative assessment, they will fail the subject and receive a grade of F#, even if their accumulated marks (overall mark) are 40% or above. (Source: 2025 Academic Handbook.pdf, page 59)
*   If a student fails their formative assessment, they will fail the subject and receive a grade of F#, even if they pass their summative assessment and their accumulated marks (overall mark) are 40% or above. (Source: 2025 Academic Handbook.pdf, page 57)

q06.answer: The convocation ceremony to celebrate graduates is normally held in November/December every year.

q07.answer: No, you cannot graduate if your CGPA is 1.90, even if you pass all your courses. The graduation requirement is a CGPA and GPA of at least 2.00. You would be required to repeat course(s) to increase your CGPA to at least 2.00 (Source: 2025 Academic Handbook.pdf, page 45).

q08.answer: For a 14-week trimester, a non-engineering student may register a maximum of 20 Credit Hours (CH).

q09.answer: To achieve First Class Honours in a Bachelor's Degree Programme, you need a CGPA between 3.67 and 4.00.

q11.answer:
To be on the Dean's List, students must fulfill the following requirements:

*   **Foundation:**
    *   Minimum GPA: 3.67
    *   Minimum Total Credit Hours for graded subjects:
        *   Long Trimester: 12
        *   Short Trimester: 6
*   **Diploma / Bachelor:**
    *   Minimum GPA: 3.50
    *   Minimum Total Credit Hours for graded subjects:
        *   Long Trimester: 12
        *   Short Trimester: 6

(Source: 2025 Academic Handbook.pdf, page 54)

q12.answer: No, you are only entitled to ONE MMU scholarship at any one time. Combining scholarships/financial aids from MMU is NOT allowed. (Source: 2026 Scholarship.pdf, page 7)

q13.answer: For the MMU President's Scholarship, recipients must maintain a CGPA of 3.50 throughout their duration of study.

q23.answer:
The Finance Office (also known as Bursary or Fees Office) is located in the Administration Building, on Level 1.

To get there:
*   Enter the Administration Building main door.
*   Take the stairs or lift to Level 1.
*   Turn right; the Finance Office is the second door.

It is located beside the Student Services Centre.

q25.answer:
The Student Service Centre (SSC) is located on the Ground Level of the Administration Building.

You can find it immediately to the left of the main entrance. It is also near the covered walkway and below the Finance Office.
